The <b>Diving Bell Key</b> is an [[Items (Silksong)#Keys|item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Used to open the [[Diving Bell|diving bell]] found at the very bottom of Deep Docks, in order to enter [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]].<ref><i>"An old diving bell. Its door is shut tight by an ornate clamp."</i></ref>

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Diving Bell 01.png!Diving Bell location in Deep Docks
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Deep Docks 14.png!Diving Bell in Deep Docks
}}

== How to Acquire ==
After speaking to the [[Snail Shamans (Silksong)|Snail Shamans]] and beginning the Main Objective <i>[[Acts#The Dark Below|SEEK: The Dark Below]]</i>, Hornet will be directed to use the diving bell in Deep Docks to reach the Abyss.<ref>[[Ballow]]: <i>"Here's the key that'll see you inside its metal belly. Pop in there once you're feelin' good and ready. In the meantime, I'll get to seeing things set up here."</i></ref>

After speaking to [[Ballow]], he will agree to pilot the diving bell and will give Hornet the key to the submersible when meeting him in the room directly above it.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Diving Bell Key.png!Diving Bell Key location in Deep Docks
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Ballow 01.png!Ballow in Deep Docks
}}

== Trivia ==
* In the 2025 pre-release demo, the Diving Bell Key sprite was used for the [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Items#Keys|Gate Key]], which was used to unlock the gate before [[Lace]]'s fight in [[Deep Docks]]. 
** This item was a reworked version of the [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Items#Keys|Dock Key]], an item with the same function that appeared in the 2019 demo and had a different sprite.
